config.promotion: Promote the adaptive candidate only if its paired-opening bootstrap 95% lower score bound exceeds 0.5 against the preserved best, score is at least 0.5 against matched control and static-clock ablation, and it has no illegal/crash/init/time failures. Otherwise retain the preserved best. Test results never enter replay or checkpoint selection.
config.architecture: Existing 935-64-32-1 policy, classical node evaluation, bounded 10cp policy preference, optional 15cp Alien preference. Value network remains preserved in prior fusion candidates; do not average incompatible weights.
config.opening_lookup: Graph is offline training only. No teacher move/evaluation lookup is shipped. Book-on/off is therefore inapplicable to the new graph; the existing hand-written optional Alien hint remains identical in control and candidates.
config.scope: Pilot, not a GM-strength claim. Current baseline has no independently calibrated human/site Elo. Exact clock tests are fresh and separate from observational human clocks. No paid resources or video transcription.

scope: Two-budget approximate engine labels except exhaustively verified short mates. No teacher lookup ships; no human timing or puzzle reward is fitted into the game-value network.
